perf(text): move web rasterization off main thread (#183)

* perf(text): move web rasterization off main thread

* fix(ci): drop committed text engine source-build hooks

CI appends hooks.user_defines.plate_text_engine itself before running
checks; committing the same block created a duplicate YAML mapping key
and broke pub get.

* fix(text): debounce prewarm and surface preview errors

- Deactivate pending prewarm work when the renderer binding is replaced.
- Debounce prewarm by 150 ms and skip stale revisions so rapid edits do
  not rasterize throwaway frames.
- Report committed-preview optimization failures through the config so
  hosts can stop live timers and show the error.
- Fall back to the main-thread engine if the Worker cannot initialize.
- Reuse hooks configuration from CI instead of committing it.

* fix(ci): expect text engine ABI 5

* test(ci): align stale export baselines

* fix(text): keep export errors through preview retry

* fix(text): guard preview error cleanup race

* test(example): include raster worker and metrics in module inventory

The text rasterization scenario now ships a web worker proxy and timing
metric stubs/web files under lib; the boundary guard's explicit module
inventory must list them.

* fix(example): restore app boundary checks

* fix(example): isolate browser route API
